method: Sequential private QEMU instances, no simultaneous regression guests; two rounds each, one active raw VNC round. Wall timings include scheduling; CPU seconds cover entire fbterm command. No fork performance gates.
baseline_runtime_source: kernel/support/string.cpp at 41af3ab; same GPU timing instrumentation as optimized kernel
limitations: Only two rounds; substantial baseline host timing variation.
In-flight byte window includes IPC and rendering, not only GPU waits.
No shared framebuffer, device-side scroll or kernel asynchronous command queue.
Additional renderer process and COW memory; intermediate visual states coalesced, PTY bytes retained.
